title: Virtua Photo Studio: Cameraman Simulation
native_title: バーチャ・フォト・スタジオ ～カメラマン・シミュレーション～
overview: Virtua Photo Studio is a live-action photo shoot game similar to the earlier Virtual Cameraman series from the same developers. The player chooses from one of three models and does a photo shoot with them; this takes the form of taking pictures as a video plays, which are saved for later viewing. After each shoot, the model will change into increasingly revealing outfits — from cosplay to lingerie to a "bonus" nude shoot.
